title: Standardize GH Param And Component Nicknames
description: The naming and descriptions of all params and components are inconsistent. Use two-letter nicknames for params with ? and * cardinality suffixes, three-letter nicknames for components, and replace generic descriptions using dictionary.csv as reference.
summary: Centralized Grasshopper naming policy now normalizes all component nicknames to 3 chars, parameter nicknames to 2 chars with cardinality suffixes, and rewrites parameter/component descriptions to non-generic, component-specific text; added reflection-based naming conformance test coverage.
